question: Should OpenClaw add a plugin-visible skill install/update completion observer now, and what redacted payload plus observer-failure semantics should it expose?
rationale: Automation can prove the missing lifecycle surface, but choosing what install metadata plugins may see and whether observer failures affect an already-written install is a security and product boundary decision.

options.title: Add observational completion hook
options.body: Add a post-install/update observer that carries redacted target/source/outcome metadata and logs handler failures without rolling back a completed install.

options.title: Keep blocking policy only
options.body: Document `security.installPolicy` and `before_install` as the supported security extension points and defer audit/compliance observation to external policy commands or ClawHub telemetry.

options.title: Reopen broader scanner design
options.body: Fold this into a larger built-in scanning or trust framework, accepting a bigger security/product design cycle before any hook API lands.

recommendation.title: Add observational completion hook
recommendation.body: Add a post-install/update observer that carries redacted target/source/outcome metadata and logs handler failures without rolling back a completed install.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already carried the public maintainer-style review for this issue and is the clearest routing owner for the remaining product/security boundary decision.
